stage: Primary chronological calibration and checked OOS probability acceptance
findings: The logistic primary used ordinary CalibratedClassifierCV inner folds, not later token-disjoint label-mature calibration. The outer net split did not correct the internal chronological calibration boundary
The LightGBM primary used a class-weighted Booster score directly as a probability without held-out calibration
Primary artifact inference and promotion checked net financial population, outer label purging and checksum but did not require supported probability semantics or actual matching calibration
The automatic retrain wrapper inferred activation from trained=true and could compare an unsupported legacy incumbent's old score against a newly checked model

implementation.primary_models: Both logistic regression and sklearn LightGBM classifier use the existing later, token-disjoint, label-mature sigmoid calibration helper. Base estimators and scaling fit only on earlier eligible observations and are not refit after calibration. Minimum calibration support includes distinct tokens per binary class. LightGBM fitting uses one worker to bound daemon CPU concurrency
implementation.outer_evaluation: Every actual outer split is independently checked for known settled event/label times, disjoint case-sensitive tokens and labels available before the next decision with a 60-second embargo. Each outer fit performs its own inner calibration. Raw scores and predict-class fallbacks cannot become primary probabilities
implementation.probability_acceptance: Persist OOS probabilities, the earlier mature train prevalence baseline, Brier loss/skill, reliability bins, class-specific token support, paired token-cluster loss uncertainty and separate inner/outer boundaries. Acceptance requires at least 30 independent outer tokens, at least five positive and negative tokens and positive baseline-relative loss skill with positive historical bootstrap lower improvement
implementation.artifact_binding: PrimaryCalibratedRanker carries the exact version and calibration metadata digest. Readers and promotion check metadata structure, row/token support, chronological folds and loss evidence, then verify actual model type and attached calibration identity against checksum-checked model bytes. Ordered binary classes and a single fitted calibrator bound to the same base estimator are required. Missing, old, uncalibrated, inconsistent or unsupported artifacts are unknown, not zero
implementation.candidate_and_entry_policy: Primary selection prefers candidates with supported OOS probabilities over unsupported higher reported EV. Unsupported early inner-calibration windows are explicitly skipped without discarding supported later windows or inventing probabilities/returns for omitted rows. Financial net, quality, purging, threshold and selected-return gates remain required; holdout acceptance counts only actual supported OOS prediction rows and positives. Unknown primary probabilities do not enforce a buy veto or create AI sizing points; independently enforced execution/risk safeguards remain unchanged
implementation.automatic_cycle: TrainResult explicitly reports active_promoted. The retrain daemon no longer reports a stored/unpromoted candidate as an active update, rejects unproved promoted metadata and cannot restore an unsupported legacy primary merely because its old incomparable metric was larger. Nonfinite and boolean selection metrics are not valid comparisons
implementation.upside_and_size: No new take-profit/runner ceiling, entry momentum cap, trade-size experiment or live activation. The exact requested 0.1 SOL paper order contract is unchanged
implementation.existing_artifacts: Existing runtime models are not trained, rewritten, promoted or deleted in this stage. Old primary artifacts without the new acceptance contract are deliberately unavailable as probabilities; only a future separately gated automatic training cycle can create supported replacements
